qualification: candidate-graph DC-continuity check and cross-revision repair comparator; no .11 internal-winding proof

source.qualification: cross-revision repair discussion and annotated K7222 schematic; not a K7222.11 factory pin map

observations.reading: The author says one winding on the ÜHA78 primary spool is originally in series with the high-voltage coil.
The author calls the original K7222 high-voltage coil footpoint grounded, without assigning that footpoint to X1:16.
The author's annotated K7222 schematic labels relevant X1 secondary windings red and an X2 primary-spool winding green.

source.interpretation_limit: The author discusses a K7222 repair without fixing the .11/.21 revision. A grounded end of a series chain does not establish that the intermediate X1:16 terminal itself is grounded. The photograph does not determine the .11 internal continuity or turn count.

interpretation: The candidate has an EHT-to-ground DC winding chain even though X1:16 is an ungrounded intermediate tap. The repair statement that the footpoint is grounded therefore cannot select the X1:16=0 variant. It is compatible with a series-winding return but does not prove the K7222.11 internal graph or polarity.
